name: UV Shield Aviator Sunglasses
description: Premium polarized aviator sunglasses with 100% UV400 protection. Lightweight titanium frame with scratch-resistant lenses. Perfect for beach days, driving, and outdoor adventures. The gradient lenses provide stylish sun protection while reducing glare.

name: Tropical Floral Sundress
description: Flowy midi sundress in a vibrant tropical floral print. Made from breathable 100% rayon fabric to keep you cool in the heat. Features adjustable spaghetti straps, a smocked bodice, and tiered skirt. Perfect for beach outings, summer parties, and vacation days.

name: SPF 50 Mineral Sunscreen
description: Reef-safe mineral sunscreen with SPF 50 broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection. Non-greasy, water-resistant formula that blends invisibly on all skin tones. Enriched with aloe vera and vitamin E for extra skin nourishment. Dermatologist tested and fragrance-free.

name: Inflatable Beach Lounger
description: Giant inflatable floating beach lounger that captures the wind to inflate in seconds — no pump needed! Fits 1-2 adults comfortably. Made from lightweight, durable ripstop nylon. Includes a built-in pillow headrest, drink holder, and storage pocket. Folds down to a compact size.

name: Straw Sun Hat
description: Wide-brim handwoven straw hat with UPF 50+ protection. Features a fashionable grosgrain ribbon band and a foldable, packable design for easy travel. The 4-inch brim shades your face, neck, and shoulders. Adjustable inner drawstring ensures a secure fit.

name: Aloe Vera After-Sun Gel
description: Soothing after-sun gel with 95% pure organic aloe vera to calm, hydrate, and repair sun-exposed skin. Infused with cucumber extract and chamomile for instant cooling relief. Non-sticky, fast-absorbing formula. Works great for sunburns, minor irritations, and general skin hydration.

name: Waterproof Beach Tote Bag
description: Spacious waterproof tote bag designed for beach days. Features a large main compartment, zipper interior pocket, and multiple exterior pockets for organization. The woven exterior looks chic while the PVC-coated interior keeps sand and water out. Fits towels, sunscreen, snacks, and more.

name: Men's Swim Trunks
description: Quick-dry men's swim trunks with a tropical print. Made from lightweight recycled polyester with a 4-way stretch for maximum mobility. Features a comfortable elastic waistband with an interior mesh brief and secure zip pocket. UPF 40+ fabric protection.
